tables.name: bundles
tables.purpose: Master record for each merchant-defined bundle, its type, enabled state, and the Shopify discount node backing it.

columns.name: id
columns.purpose: internal id

columns.name: bundle_type
columns.purpose: fixed or flexible

columns.name: required_item_count
columns.purpose: for flexible bundles: how many items the customer must pick from the pool

columns.name: discount_type
columns.purpose: percentage, flat, or bxgy

columns.name: shopify_discount_external_id
columns.purpose: Shopify DiscountCodeNode id, stored so the discount can be updated or deleted when the bundle changes

columns.name: discount_code_string
columns.purpose: the code string generated by Shopify at bundle creation time; used to apply the discount via cartDiscountCodesUpdate and to match against discount_codes[].code in the orders/create webhook payload for purchase-count attribution

columns.name: purchase_count
columns.purpose: incremented each time this bundle is added to a cart and confirmed via order creation

tables.name: bundle_items
tables.purpose: Each product/variant slot that belongs to a bundle's fixed set or flexible pool.

columns.name: id
columns.purpose: internal id

columns.name: bundle_id
columns.constraints: NOT NULL REFERENCES bundles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.purpose: parent bundle

columns.name: product_external_id
columns.purpose: Shopify product id for this slot

columns.name: variant_mode
columns.purpose: all (any variant) or specific (only listed variants)

columns.name: available
columns.purpose: set false when products/update shows the product inactive or products/delete fires; widget reads this to show disabled state

tables.name: bundle_item_variants
tables.purpose: Explicit variant constraints for bundle items whose variant_mode is 'specific'.

columns.name: id
columns.purpose: internal id

columns.name: bundle_item_id
columns.constraints: NOT NULL REFERENCES bundle_items(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.purpose: parent bundle item

columns.name: variant_external_id
columns.purpose: Shopify ProductVariant numeric id allowed for this slot

columns.name: variant_gid
columns.purpose: Full Shopify ProductVariant GID (gid://shopify/ProductVariant/<id>); stored at bundle creation time from the admin picker so the widget can use it directly for cartLinesAdd without reconstructing

tables.name: bundle_discount_tiers
tables.purpose: Tiered discount rules for a bundle; the best-matching tier is selected at checkout based on item count.

columns.name: id
columns.purpose: internal id

columns.name: bundle_id
columns.constraints: NOT NULL REFERENCES bundles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.purpose: parent bundle

columns.name: min_item_count
columns.purpose: minimum number of items in the bundle to qualify for this tier

columns.name: discount_ratio
columns.purpose: populated when discount_type is percentage; mutually exclusive with discount_amount

columns.name: discount_amount
columns.purpose: populated when discount_type is flat; mutually exclusive with discount_ratio

columns.name: is_bxgy
columns.purpose: true when this tier represents a buy-X-get-one-free rule; discount_ratio and discount_amount are both null in this case

tables.name: bundle_order_increments
tables.purpose: Deduplication ledger ensuring purchase_count is incremented at most once per order per bundle.

columns.name: id
columns.purpose: internal id

columns.name: bundle_id
columns.constraints: NOT NULL REFERENCES bundles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.purpose: bundle whose count was incremented

columns.name: order_external_id
columns.purpose: Shopify order id that triggered the increment
